correctness.rationale: The Schmidt pure-state density has local Bloch vectors (0,0,r) and correlation tensor diag(C,-C,1). With Alice equatorial, p(x)=1/2 and the exact conditional channel is W_C(y|x)=[1+y u+xy C t]/2, u=r b_z, t=a_x b_x-a_y b_y. The Bell comparator channel W_1(y0|x)=[1+x y0 t]/2. For t!=0 comparison of input-conditional means forces any output stochastic map to have affine parameters alpha=u,beta=C, which is feasible precisely when |u|+C<=1; the explicit 2x2 kernel verifies sufficiency. For t=0 the channel is input independent and automatic. Classically degraded output mutual information is <= Bell mutual information; apply Grudka et al. Theorem 3 to each of two pairs to obtain the 2+log2(c prime) upper bound. Physical domain C∈[0,1], lambda∈[0,1] includes separable and Bell boundary (Bell covered without cone), and cone equivalence for C<1 is algebraic. Independent exact rational channel composition tests agree.
